source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

notes.languages: one language depending on its mortal life; telepathy 30 feet

items.name: Unsubstantiated Consciousness
items.text: When an imperfect automaton succeeds at a Will save, it gets a critical success instead. When it fails at a Will save, it gets a critical failure instead.

items.name: Empty Wail
items.text:
The imperfect automaton utters a mournful cry in a 30-foot cone. The cry deals 4d6 mental damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 Will save save). The imperfect automaton can't use its Empty Wail again for 1d4 rounds.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Stupefied 1 for 1d4+1 rounds.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is stupefied 1 for 1d4+1 rounds and Stunned 1.

items.name: Impassioned Strikes
items.text: While the imperfect automaton is affected by an emotion effect, its fist Strikes deal 1d6 additional mental damage.

foundry.label: Automaton is affected by an effect with the emotion trait

items.name: Mortal Reflection
items.text:
Requirements The imperfect automaton has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

---

Effect The imperfect automaton draws upon the target's emotions to recall a semblance of mortal feeling, gaining a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed for 1 minute. If the grabbed or restrained creature has an ongoing emotion or mental effect with a counteract rank of 4 or lower, the imperfect automaton can gain a copy of that effect that lasts for 1 minute.

Effect: Mortal Reflection
